title: BCC Ruling No. 19-12-1532 — fire-department access to a laneway house
code_edition: Ontario Building Code 2012, O. Reg. 332/12 (as cited)

facts.text: The ruling describes a proposed two-storey laneway house at 572 Palmerston Avenue with 48 m² of parking space on the first storey and 60 m² of residential space on the second, timber construction, and NFPA-13R sprinklers.
The applicant described side passage widths of about 0.9 m and 0.95 m; the City reported that meters, piping, and equipment further reduced clear width.
The dispute cites Article 9.10.20.3. and Appendix A-9.10.20.3. concerning access for fire-department equipment.
